title: Every Noise at Once
creator: everynoise.com
description: A scannable map of ~6,000 music genres, each a clickable audio sample.
note:
A single page that plots *every* genre Spotify has a name for onto one scatter map — down and left is denser and more atmospheric, up and right is spikier and bouncier.

Click anything and it plays. `wonky`, `escape room`, `vapor twitch`, `deep discofox` — genres you didn't know had names, arranged so neighbours actually sound like neighbours.

> The whole thing is one guy's side project running off Spotify's audio-analysis data.

I've lost whole evenings just wandering it.
